## Review gates

- [ ] Greptile 5/5 confirmed
- Vault review note link:

## Pre-PR self-check

- [ ] Typecheck passes
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Production build passes
- [ ] Diff checked for console.log, TODO/FIXME, commented-out code, mock/placeholder/sample data, hardcoded values, and secrets
- [ ] User-facing strings checked for technology, provider, or path leakage
- [ ] Tenant isolation and authorization verified where relevant
- [ ] Audit entries verified for mutations
- [ ] No new runtime dependency outside docs/technology-stack.md
- [ ] No secret values, environment values, or provider responses in commit or PR text
